Dear Miss Yonge	
[Mr Maclear](/person/937)’s address is
Rev G. F. M. 24 Elgin Crescent
Kensington Park Gardens[[footnote:1]
Many thanks for your kind [illegible] about the [illustrations](/topic/167). [I](/person/939)think on the whole it would be dangerous to employ an unpractised pencil.[^2] On some future occasion I shall be very glad indeed.
My people at home have been reading your [cameos](/book/73), and think they would make a nice book.[^3] I am inclined to think so too - in a cheap form

Yours ever truly
A. Macmillan


[^2]: CMY had tried to persuade him to use [Katie Johns](/person/887) as illustrator of [The Prince and the Page](/book/61).
[^3]: CMY had been producing “Cameos from English History” for the MP since the beginning of 1851, and 70 had appeared by the time of this letter.
